_what_this_is: A one-use maintainer decision. It states who permitted what, at what cumulative spend, against what cap, and what it does NOT authorize. It deliberately asserts no derived identity: the timestamp, the committed base, the harness digest, the session plan hash and the science plan hash are all computed by scripts/autoinit/issue_phase_a_authorization.py, which refuses a grant that claims any of them. Consumed by exactly one issuance; not reusable.
granted_by: Maintainer decision, recorded in the Phase-A readiness review of 2026-08-18. GO for Phase-A Attempt 8, and Attempt 8 only. The decision follows the readiness closure at commit 7ede6501457a5b9c54fa98e4161bea96917e2024, which made the session manifest authoritative for relay science-input staging: the shared setup no longer names any relay path, destination or digest, the real staging block is executed at $0 before a provider is contacted, every new gate is mutation-verified, the full suite is 1872 passed / 11 skipped / 0 errors, the pod simulator is 1832 passed / 22 skipped with the artifact tree restored exactly, the frozen-asset verifier passes, and Phase-A pricing reproduces to the digit. covers: One (1) launch of AutoInitializer Phase A, attempt 8, on a single NVIDIA L40S at no more than $0.99/h, executing the frozen Phase-A protocol through its six stages under the existing watchdog, soft-stop, hard-stop, artifact-collection and provider-confirmed teardown behaviour. Reviving the device canary, which remains strategically terminated. Any other paid session, generation run, evaluation run or storage operation. Any change to the frozen science: science plan 02be33b9, session plan 9377a2dc, Stage-3 protocol 250f72ef, equivalence interval 0.011695296982299022, feasibility floor 0.3, the sa/sb and conditional sc seed policy, the recovery, search and selection rules, or the permanent controls and frozen checkpoints. fail_closed_instruction: If any authorization, lineage, bundle-identity, relay-input, setup, pricing, provider-price, Stage-0 or Stage-1 readiness gate fails: do not repair around the gate on the live pod. Record the evidence, terminate with provider confirmation, and stop for review.
on_completion: Report commits and hashes, authorization identity, bundle round-trip result, provider/pod lifecycle, stage-by-stage result, actual spend, collected artifacts, teardown confirmation and the scientific result. Do not independently authorize a subsequent attempt.
